svg.title: LAYOUT-001 tungsten–quartz forward calorimeter: 3D cutaway
svg.desc: Orthographic cutaway of one 1800 mm annular FCAL, with 50 mm bore radius, 290 mm outer radius, a 1200 mm tungsten sampling block, selected long and short quartz fibres, 300 mm rear optical fan-out and SiPM readout. An inset shows all 96 sensor cartridges. Both detector ends are placed at absolute z 4533.2 to 6333.2 mm. Prototype, with representative enlarged fibres and removed material for visibility.
